pr_title: Another theoretical fix for another race condition
pr_body:
Basically, just make sure that we register our `SettingsChanged` handler in `TerminalWindow` _after_ `TerminalWindow` is actually ready to handle it. _duh_. 

Closes #15209

issue_context.title: 1.18 - RACE - Settings can reload while window is being constructed
issue_context.body:
At least 1x on my dev box, I observed the following:

- Main thread is crashing in TerminalWindow::UpdateSettings because `_root` is `nullptr`, while trying to call `_root->Dispatcher()`.
- The window thread is actively constructing the UI and has not yet assigned `_root`.

Boom
comments:
Noted while digging:

`AppLogic` is reaching inside `TerminalWindow` to register `TerminalWindow` for `AppLogic`'s `SettingsChanged` event. It does this quite early (and I was bothered that it happened inside AppLogic?)

review_comments:
If I'm not mistaken, this trades one theoretical problem for another one though... Now it's possible to miss a settings update in the time between `TerminalWindow` creation and startup. But that's better than crashing so I'm convinced we should just merge this. 😅

I think one way to fix this would be to not pass any settings to the `TerminalWindow` constructor and instead have `TerminalWindow` pull the settings from `AppLogic` the same way you ask it for `SettingsChanged` events now. If we do that after calling `SettingsChanged()`, it'll be impossible to miss any updates, because `UpdateSettings` yields to the UI thread and thus must run after `Create()` returns.

We can also implement other options of course, since reaching back into `AppLogic` feels a little sneaky, similar to `ServiceLocator`. Like delaying the update until we flag a `std::latch` to signal that updating the settings is now safe, etc. If you want to solve this at some point and need help, let me know!

Until then I personally think it would be nice to note this down as a code comment there, so we don't forget about it. We can make it a github issue, but idk... it's like a P5 bug now.
